question.text: A VALUE investment strategy looks for:

answer.text: Stocks trading below intrinsic value (low P/E, P/B, high dividend)

explanation.text: The Logic: Value = cheap relative to fundamentals. Mean-reversion payoff when market recognises intrinsic value. The Trap: Avoid value-traps. Cross-Exam Context: Topic 18. Manager's Pro-Tip: Combine value screens with quality (RoE, low debt) filters to avoid deteriorating companies.
